What's happening to the world's icebergs?

Starting today, you can explore major Arctic and Antarctic icebergs on My!hū.

When building My!hū, we wanted environmental intelligence to be more accessible than scattered reports and disconnected datasets. That's why we've added iceberg tracking alongside our existing layers for deforestation, land loss, and endangered species.

The result is a growing map-first platform that helps people, researchers, organisations, and communities better understand environmental change as it unfolds.

Small update. Big step toward a more comprehensive environmental intelligence platform.

Feedback is always welcome.
